docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $1,130.00 FILED BY LEE, GEORGE AS TO DEFENDANT FREYTES, GLORIA ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUN-27-1994 AT 07:00 PM IN DEPT 01
